_description: Spouse SS income uses spouse age for year mapping. Two SS events with different owners start in different calendar years based on their respective ages.
_rationale: Primary age 60, spouse age 58, referenceYear 2026. Self SS $24k at age 65 → startYear = 2026 + (65-60) = 2031. Spouse SS $18k at age 67 → startYear = 2026 + (67-58) = 2035. No growth, no tax (Florida), no inflation, fixed COLA, no haircut. Balance grows by $24k/yr from 2031, then $42k/yr from 2035.
name: SS Spouse
